fields.description: Secret token embedded in the verification link, used to look up and verify this request.
fields.label: Request Key

fields.description: Alternate email the invite/verification link is sent to; also saved on the created account's settings.
fields.label: Backup Email

fields.description: The Suite Admin or System Manager who created this request.
fields.label: Invited By

fields.description: Whether the backup email has been verified via the invite link or OTP.
fields.label: Is Verified

fields.description: Whether the request has passed its expiry time. Computed at read time.
fields.label: Is Expired

fields.description: Primary email address; becomes the Frappe User and the Stalwart account's primary address.
fields.label: Account

fields.description: Additional email addresses (one per line) added as aliases to the account.
fields.label: Aliases

fields.description: Disk quota in GB applied to the account on creation, where 0 means unlimited. Left blank, the configured default disk quota is used.
fields.label: Disk Quota (GB)

fields.description: Stalwart group ids (one per line) the account is added to on creation.
fields.label: Groups

fields.description: Stalwart mailing list ids (one per line) the account's primary address is added to as a recipient on creation.
fields.label: Mailing Lists

fields.description: If enabled, emails a verification link to the backup email; otherwise the account is created immediately.
fields.label: Send Invite

fields.description: IP address the request was created from.
fields.label: IP Address

fields.description: When this request stops being valid and can no longer create an account.
fields.label: Expires At

fields.description: Stalwart roles (one per line) assigned to the account on creation; defaults are chosen by the admin flag.
fields.label: Roles

fields.description: If enabled, the created user gets the Suite Admin role and admin Stalwart roles.
fields.label: Is Admin
